intro: Your opponent is ready, it’s time to faceoff!
description:
Get ready to faceoff!

Jaleco's classic sports trio puts you up against the toughest competition around, where every serve, dunk, and slapshot is a chance to prove who’s got the most game.

Whether you're delivering a ferocious backhand in a championship tennis match, connecting on a sweet bounce pass in a street basketball showdown, or crashing the crease in a full contact hockey barnburner, one thing is certain – your opponent is ready for you.

So lace up your kicks, grip your racket, and drop the puck – it’s time to faceoff!

Racket Attack / Moero!! Pro Tennis (NES™, 1988 - 1994)

- Realistic tennis moves including lobs, volleys, and slices.
- Choose from 8 men's and 8 women's players, each with unique strengths and weaknesses.
- Tournament mode lets you battle through seven increasingly difficult matches to claim the championship trophy.
- 2-player exhibition mode for going head-to-head against a friend.
-  Multiple court surfaces to play on.

Hoops / Moero!! Junior Basket - Two on Two (NES™, 1988 - 1989)

- Half-court street basketball with fast, arcade-style action.
- Realistic moves – blocked shots, steal the ball, pass, or drive hard to the hoop.
- 8 unique characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matchups, team up or go it alone.
- Two courts to choose from.
- Play solo against the computer or with a friend.

Pro Sport Hockey / USA Ice Hockey (NES™/Super NES™, 1993-1994)

- Realistic hockey simulation with slap shots, slick passes, body checks, and penalties.
- Choose from a league of 24 unique teams.
- Play an exhibition or official game, or special practice modes.
- Includes a regulation 84 game season schedule, playoffs and cup finals.
- Create and change lines for any situation: scoring, checking, power plays.
- 1 player vs. computer, 2-player head-to-head, and computer vs. computer modes.

Authentic Action – Feel the excitement of every dunk, wrist shot, and smash with intuitive controls and strategic gameplay.

Seamlessly switch between the NES™ and Super NES™ versions anytime including regional releases of all games.

Rewind the action like a VHS tape – missed that shot? Go back in time and try again!

Need help? The original manuals are built-in and always ready to guide you!

Retro Presentation – Play with a classic TV CRT filter or with the many other display options for the ultimate nostalgia.

Compete against the world and your friends on the monthly leaderboards.

With Remote Play support you can play on the go and invite your friends from around the globe to play a friendly vs match, team up for a tournament, or battle for the cup together.


Whether you're a longtime fan of the Jaleco sports series or a newcomer ready to experience some of the most beloved sports franchises in history – gear up as it’s time to faceoff!
